_howToUpdate: HOLES — add an object to a course's `holes` array once you have a clip:
number is the only required field; par, notes and youtubeId are all optional.
youtubeId takes a bare ID or a pasted URL (youtu.be, watch?v=, /shorts/).
While `holes` is empty the page shows a few empty slots so you can see where clips will go.
Set "videoSlots": 4 on a course to change how many empty slots it shows.
REVIEWS — one entry per player, keyed by their name in players.json:
condition and fun are 1-5. thoughts is free text. All three are optional.
Course averages and who still owes a review are worked out from these.
PHOTO — point `photo` at a real image in images/ and it shows above the course.
Leave it off (or on the placeholder SVG) and no image is rendered at all.
